title: Consumers Will Kill Agentic Payments Before Regulators Do
brief: 55% of consumers won't let agents pay autonomously. The real blocker isn't law or rails — it's consent. And nobody building the infrastructure is solving for that.

title: Visa's Real Agentic Payments Moat Is Issuer Liability Protection, Not Network Rails
brief: Everyone thinks Visa owns agentic payments via protocol dominance. The real moat is Reg E issuer liability — and that doesn't protect Visa the network the way most assume.
